title: Consolidation: Idiom & Figurative Language
goal: Bring together everyday idioms, figurative prepositional verbs, manner frames, fronting and figurative gerunds.
grammar: c1-idiom-figurative-vocab, verbos-regimen-preposicional, manner-clauses, inversion-enfasis-fronting, gerundio-acciones-paralelas, imperfect-subjunctive-forms

items: I can use everyday Spanish idioms and figurative expressions accurately in speech and writing.
I can combine figurative prepositional verbs and proverbial manner frames with accurate grammar.
I can front figurative phrases with inversion and use figurative gerunds to convey attitude.
